items.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: As far as singers he had Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Sarah Vaughan, Helen Humes, the best.

ctx.x: Nobody could do that but Norman Granz. And he should be well honored for that you know, the best. As far as singers he had Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Sarah Vaughan, Helen Humes, the best. The best in the world. And I don’t know of anybody else that

could do that. That was the highlights of everybody’s life for heaven’s sake. It was mine. The alto players were the best, Charlie Parker, Benny Carter, Johnny Hodges, you couldn’t top that. Well in San Francisco we outdrew a Barnum & Bailey so that’ll tell you.
